intuition: A palindrome reads the same in both directions. Compare the next relevant character from each end while ignoring punctuation, spaces, and case.

brute_force.approach: Build a normalized string containing only alphanumeric characters, then compare it with its reverse.

optimal.approach: Move two pointers inward, skipping non-alphanumeric characters and comparing the case-folded characters in place.

edge_cases: A string with no alphanumeric characters is a palindrome.
Skip punctuation and whitespace before comparing.
